probe.scope: Owned temporary file and actual Windows sharing lock; no native model or provider execution

scope: Local recorder repair proof, separate from the original native Codex attempt and its outcome. The original native source snapshot and receipts were not changed.

repair.pending_bytes: Each failed write retains its own uniquely named temporary JSON; existing target stays intact until successful replace.
repair.snapshot_failure: Exclusive fallback receipt retains failure and in-memory observation; execution continues observing the owned process.
repair.failure_classification: Snapshot faults are snapshot_recording_error; only failures before Popen are launch_error. Other postlaunch I/O faults trigger controlled cleanup and runner_io_error.
